subject: Audit/access log export: slice delivery, tombstones, and TTL guarantees
messages:
From: Antonio Ruiz <antonio.ruiz@finvero.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We're finalizing our procurement checklist for log handback and have a couple of technical requirements we need to confirm before the contract signature:

- Can Redwood deliver time-windowed slices (e.g., hourly/daily) for tenant audit/access logs rather than a single monolithic dump?
- Do exported payloads include a tombstone marker or deletion flag so we can reconcile deletion events in our retention reports?
- What formats do you support (CSV, NDJSON, Parquet)? Any recommended schemas?
- What is the typical SLA for a bulk export (and are accelerated windows available)?
- We will need a proof-of-deletion attestation for records covered by our legal hold process — can you describe the process and what artifacts you provide?

If you can share a sample manifest and a small sample payload that shows the tombstone/deletion marker, that would help our security team sign off.

Thanks,
Antonio
Antonio Ruiz
Finvero — Security & Controls
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Antonio Ruiz <antonio.ruiz@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones

Hi Antonio — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then we'll follow with concrete artifacts: 

- Sliced delivery: yes. We can export hourly, daily, or custom windows; large date ranges are chunked into < 50GB slices by default.
- Tombstones/deletion flags: yes — we include a deletions field in the manifest and a tombstone event in the export payload (deletion_reason + deletion_timestamp).
- Formats: NDJSON and gzipped NDJSON are our default for logs; CSV is possible for flattened fields; Parquet on request for analytics customers.
- SLA: standard bulk export lead time is 7 business days; expedited 48–72 hour windows are available for an additional services fee.
- Proof-of-deletion: we provide an export manifest with tombstone records, and can produce a signed attestation of export + a computed checksum manifest. For long-running legal holds we can also produce an audit timeline PDF.

I'll loop in our export engineer (Karthik) for specifics on window limits and schema. Marissa will attach the example manifest and a small sample payload.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones (internal details)

Marissa / Kimberly — internal tech notes to include in the reply:

- Max window / chunking: our exporter prefers windows <= 24 hours for throughput predictability. For very large tenants we chunk by time + object size (default 10–50GB per slice). We can increase chunk size for customers on Dedicated.
- Tombstone model: we emit a tombstone line in the NDJSON payload: {"event_type": "deletion", "record_id": "...", "deletion_timestamp": "...", "deletion_reason": "user_request|sys_purge|legal_hold_release"} and we also surface deletion entries in the manifest.csv with a tombstone column.
- Retention interplay: exported data is a point-in-time extract. If a record was deleted prior to the export window, you'll only see the deletion event if it occurred within the requested window; otherwise it won't appear. For guaranteed evidence of prior deletions we can run a history reconciliation job (adds 2–4 business days).
- Encryption & delivery: exports are staged to an S3 bucket with server-side encryption; delivery via pre-signed URL OR direct S3 cross-account copy (preferred for large sets).
- Proofs: we provide SHA256 checksums for every slice and an overall manifest checksum; we can sign the manifest with our export key and include a generation timestamp.

I'll attach an internal sample payload and a small manifest that matches what we send. Feel free to redact any field values before sending externally.

-- Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Antonio Ruiz <antonio.ruiz@finvero.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, security@finvero.com
Date: 2028-10-20T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones

Hi Antonio — attaching the artifacts you requested and summarizing the operating points below. Attachments: finvero_example_manifest.csv, sample-export-20281020.json (gzipped NDJSON sample).

Summary:
- Delivery slices: we can provide hourly or daily slices. For your initial handback, we recommend daily slices for a 90-day window — that keeps slice size manageable.
- Tombstone & manifest: manifest includes column tombstone:boolean, deletion_timestamp, deletion_reason. Each export slice contains explicit tombstone events as described by Karthik.
- Formats supported: gzipped NDJSON (default), CSV (flattened), Parquet (on request).
- Export SLA: Standard 7 business days from request + approval. Expedited 48–72 hours for emergency export (requires PO/expedite fee).
- Delivery & encryption: AES-256 server-side encryption; we provide per-slice SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest. Delivery via pre-signed S3 URLs (HTTPS) or cross-account copy to your bucket.
- Proof-of-deletion: we can produce a signed attestation PDF plus a manifest of tombstone records. For legal hold reconciliation we run an additional history-replay export (2–4 business days).

Next steps:
1) If the artifacts look good, confirm desired slice cadence (hourly/daily) and final window.
2) Tell us destination (pre-signed URL vs cross-account bucket) and whether you want Parquet.
3) We will generate the export job and share presigned links + checksums.

Link to our internal export manifest guide: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/finvero/export-manifest

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- finvero_example_manifest.csv (CSV, 4KB)
- sample-export-20281020.json.gz (NDJSON sample, 18KB)
From: Antonio Ruiz <antonio.ruiz@finvero.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, security@finvero.com
Date: 2028-10-20T14:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones

Marissa — this is great, thanks. Two quick clarifications before we circulate to procurement:

1) Default retention: does Redwood’s standard tenant audit log retention stay at 90 days for hosted customers? Can it be extended to 12 months for an enterprise SLA?
2) Proof-of-deletion: for the signed attestation, will that include a manifest-level checksum AND the list of tombstone record_ids? Procurement wants to ensure we can map the attestation back to the exported objects.

If you can reply with a short checklist (what procurement needs to include in the PO) we can move forward this week.

Thanks,
Antonio
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Antonio Ruiz <antonio.ruiz@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, security@finvero.com
Date: 2028-10-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs export questions — slices, TTL, tombstones

Antonio — short procurement checklist and answers below. Attaching export_delivery_checklist.pdf for you to drop into the PO.

Answers:
- Retention: hosted default is 90 days. We offer a configurable retention addendum for enterprise customers to extend to 12 months (or custom) as part of a Dedicated or Private plan. We can include an explicit retention period in the SOW.
- Attestation contents: yes — the signed attestation includes the manifest-level SHA256 checksum, the per-slice checksums, and an attached CSV of tombstone record_ids with deletion timestamps. That CSV is generated at export time and is cryptographically linked to the manifest (signed).

Procurement checklist (summary to include in PO):
1) Export window and slice cadence (e.g., 2028-07-01 to 2028-09-30, daily slices)
2) Delivery method (pre-signed S3 URL or cross-account copy) and destination bucket if cross-account
3) Requested format (gzipped NDJSON / Parquet / CSV)
4) Encryption & key preference (SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS)
5) Expedited delivery toggle (standard = 7 business days; expedited = 48–72 hours + fee)
6) Request for attestation (signed manifest + tombstone CSV)
7) Contact for transfer and verification (name + email)

Next steps: once you confirm cadence and delivery method we will schedule the export job and share presigned links + checksums. I’ll copy our security/compliance contact if you want the formal attestation template.

Regards,
Kimberly

Attachment: export_delivery_checklist.pdf (1 page)
